{{Top|leg}}
'''Lishin''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of coral that was indigenous to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] crafted dinnerware out of the coral because of its beauty.

Many Mon Calamari [[Gender/Legends|females]] were named after the species.
